note: Superior NF rustic campground on White Pine Lake, 2.5 mi up Forest Road 164 (Honeymoon Trail) from the Caribou Trail above Lutsen, with a boat launch and an accessible fishing pier; no garbage service, so everything is packed out. Pad lengths are not posted beyond the forest's 'longer than 21 feet'. --Claude
